Aishiteru Game wo Owarasetai (Anime) add (All reviews)
Oct 27, 2026
whyyyyyyyyyy
Mixed Feelings
The author needs to learn the magic of abandoning a romcom premise in service of continuing to develop the relationship. If the premise is inherently something that insists on hampering development, then you're stuck running in place until the audience gets frustrated or bored.

This story had a ton of potential, and was all around a nice first season. If this ever gets a second season it will likely be where the cracks become really pronounced, where here they are simply showing. Our two main characters have a ton of chemistry, and have the focus of the show near entirely on them. However, the worst ... mistake this series makes is not abandoning the premise - for every step forward our MC's take, they then take 1 step back and undercut the moment under the guise of the titular "love game". Every single time. They're essentially just ragebaiting each other (and themselves) for the entire season.

If you're ok with that you'll probably really enjoy this - there's some extremely cute moments, especially later in the series. If not, then you're probably like me and will have a decent time this season but won't stick around for a second. Nothing is inherently bad, but the dogged insistence of sticking to the premise, combined with an overindulgence of inferiority, will probably play worse with some crowds than others.

7/10 - loved the concept, not so much the execution

Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen - Kashin-tan (Anime) add (All reviews)

Bloodshin
Recommended
Bleach delivers an unforgettable journey filled with iconic character designs, high-stakes battles, and unique supernatural lore. From Ichigo Kurosaki's growth as a Substitute Soul Reaper to the memorable Captains of the Gotei 13, the characters drive the emotional weight and excitement of the series.

Art & Sound

The visual presentation paired with an incredible soundtrack creates a distinct atmosphere that standsout in anime history. Studio Pierrot brought Kubo's distinct style to life with legendary battle choreography and iconic musical themes.

Final Thoughts

Whether discussing the Soul Society arc, the Arrancar saga, or the Thousand-Year Blood War, Bleach remains a cornerstone of anime culture that has touched millions of fans ... around the world.

Kubo-Sensei, Studio Pierrot, The Whole Crew and the Bleach Community: Thank You for Everything and more. That's all.
